description: This file defines the interface for a common clock service in Android, including classes for clock listener and clock control, with methods for time synchronization and service management.

classes.name: ICommonClockListener
classes.description: Interface for clock timeline change notifications.

classes.name: BnCommonClockListener
classes.description: Binder interface implementation for clock listener.

classes.name: ICommonClock
classes.description: Interface for the common clock service, providing time synchronization and status methods.

classes.name: BnCommonClock
classes.description: Binder interface implementation for the common clock.

methods.name: onTimelineChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when the clock timeline changes.

methods.name: onTransact
methods.description: Handles incoming binder transactions for clock listener and clock service.

methods.name: isCommonTimeValid
methods.description: Checks if the common time is valid.

methods.name: commonTimeToLocalTime
methods.description: Converts common time to local time.

methods.name: localTimeToCommonTime
methods.description: Converts local time to common time.

methods.name: getCommonFreq
methods.description: Retrieves the frequency of the common clock.

methods.name: getLocalFreq
methods.description: Retrieves the frequency of the local clock.

methods.name: getEstimatedError
methods.description: Gets the estimated error of the clock.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Gets the current state of the clock.

methods.name: getMasterAddr
methods.description: Retrieves the address of the master clock.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Helper to connect to the ICommonClock service.
